text:
marie_cs: quick heads-up — Greenleaf onboarding session this week showed their latency P95 for chat at ~720ms, and token cost is spiking on long-context tickets. renewal signal low if we can't show quick wins :grimace:
akash_se: thanks, digging into traces now. looks like most slow tails are on their ‘support-thread’ route where they send 2.5k token contexts repeatedly. cache hit < 10%
jon_eng: can we try a routing + quantization experiment? propose: route short/simple prompts to a compact int8 model, long threads to higher-capacity fp16 but with KV caching and prefix strip. should reduce unit cost and p95
lauren_am: flagged for renewal check — I'll loop AE once we have concrete numbers. can we put a one-page before/after for execs?
akash_se: rough config I’d try for a canary (internal):
```
route: support-thread
policies:
  - if: request.tokens <= 256
    model: rdx-compact-int8-v1
    quant: int8
    cache: prefix:true
  - else:
    model: rdx-standard-fp16-v2
    cache: kv:true
    batching: auto
```
jon_eng: also enable fallback rule to standard model on error rate > 1% and add canary traffic 5% -> 25% over 48h. collect latency/cost deltas and quality eval on sampled prompts
marie_cs: nice. can we run a short eval on 200 representative tickets to sanity-check QA before canary? I'll coordinate with their PM for dataset
lauren_am: pls add a simple ROI calc in the canary doc. AE needs to show ops savings vs current spend — even a projected 20% cost reduction will help renewal convo
akash_se: noted. I’ll spin up metric dashboards: p95, p50, cost/token, model-fallback-rate, exact-match on 200 eval prompts
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for Greenleaf support-thread route — start=1798002000, window=48h, initial_weight=5%
jon_eng: for rollout notes: add prompt-sanitization step to trim verbose system notes (we observed lots of autopasted logs). small text rewrite reduces token count a lot
marie_cs: action items: 1) akash to run eval and create dashboards (ETA 24h) 2) jon to draft routing/rollback playbook 3) lauren to prep exec ROI slide 4) i'll schedule sync with Greenleaf PM after first 24h canary results
lauren_am: adding AE to thread after we have the slide. also capture any qualitative feedback during canary — please note if any hallucination/regression
akash_se: starting eval now. quick note: we'll include both int8 and fp16 outputs in the sample to compare quality metrics side-by-side. will post results here
marie_cs: thanks team — let's aim to have the canary green before the renewal touchpoint. :crossed_fingers:
